decision.outcome: Leave the councillor vacancy unfilled until the 2027 ordinary local government election

finding: Jason Weeks, elected in October 2023, resigned as councillor effective 3 November 2026. The published minutes of the 17 November Council meeting (item 11.1, pages 14-16) record a unanimous 7/0 decision to leave the vacancy unfilled until the 2027 ordinary local government election, noting the Electoral Commissioner's approval. The report refers to October 2027; no exact polling date, closing hour, nomination timetable or candidate is established by this decision. Decision checked 28 November 2026.
limits: The published minutes establish the Council decision, replacing the earlier officer-recommendation-only status. An exact ordinary-election day or voting cutoff is not supplied by this decision; no countdown is activated.
The PDF has an undated confirmation field on its introductory page. This review does not assert a subsequent confirmation date, signature or gazettal.
The original resignation evidence, historical elections, current roster entries and their separate source dates remain unchanged. This is not a full current-officeholder audit.

The source was checked through a fresh ordinary origin HTTP response; web crawl age is not substituted for that response. Web PDF screenshot retrieval failed with a cache miss; no visual browser acceptance is claimed.
nextCheck: Check a later official timetable or notice for the 2027 ordinary election and any later vacancy decision.
